description: This file defines an abstract test case class 'KernelTestCase' for setting up unit tests within the OrangeHRM project, specifically for initializing services, creating mock objects, and managing dependencies related to the framework's kernel and service container.

classes.name: KernelTestCase
classes.description: An abstract class extending TestCase that provides utility methods for setting up the testing environment, including service initialization, kernel creation, and request generation.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Clears the entity manager and reinitializes the kernel after each test.

methods.name: getHttpRequest
methods.description: Creates and returns a new HTTP Request object with specified parameters.

methods.name: createKernel
methods.description: Initializes the application kernel, resets services, and returns a mocked Framework instance.

methods.name: createKernelWithMockServices
methods.description: Creates the kernel with additional mock services injected.

methods.name: updateOptions
methods.description: Updates internal options for the test configuration.

methods.name: setHelperServices
methods.description: Sets up mocked helper services unless disabled by options.

methods.name: setBaseServices
methods.description: Sets up core services provided by the framework unless disabled by options.
